chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.text:
1. I remember when we first said the I love yous...after the lovely, but a bit exhausting day at the cow festival. We have decided to do a spontaneous trip to a nearby waterfall. First of many :). The shadows made the heat bearable and the coolness of the air around the water helped a lot as well. I was so so happy to be able to show you one of the best foods we have in the Balkans - cevapcici.

As lovely as the whole day was, I was a bit bummed out I couldn't show you the auto train view...we did manage to turn it around and ended up with a glorious view of the nearby hills. I remember right as we have reached the bottom of the hill you told me how awesome it will be that our kids would be multilingual :). I think that was the first time i noticed just how long of a game we are playing. Right then and there i wanted to just go out and say i love you...but i didn't. Not because I would be scared that it would be real, but because i knew i couldn't comprehend just how much i would be able to love you.

I normally don't let long days get to me, but i think that day it did. I remember when we just barely missed the bus and i think i projected a little how tired i was onto you. I truly wanted to be strong for you and expected for it to drain me out even more. But instead, i just felt another shoulder besides me and someone trying on the other side as well. This gave me so much strength I don't think I felt tired at all for the entire bus ride. You just made it so easy to be there for you and I think that only hit me right when we hopped into the car. I just looked at you and all doubt left my mind forever. It's you. It has always been you. And this is why I love you. <3

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.text: 2. Talking to you is the easiest thing possible. I can never tell what you are feeling while im telling you things. And it truly makes me able to form my own opinions, even though they are mostly the same as yours :). I am so grateful to have this opportunity to grow along side you. So grateful to have you on this journey. To be able to have the space to grow. So thank you from the bottom of my heart. Thank you for listening. And this is why i love you. <3

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.text: 3. I remember when we decided on a spontaneous study visit :) im so glad that we had a spontaneous moment and pulled the trigger on the flixbus ticket :) i dont know what it could compare to, but i just remember how overwhelming the studies were, but just how easy everything was when i arrived there. I felt so truly taken care of and so loved. Even though the study materials and exams were super hard, it truly felt as it we were both in it together and the burden was not only on me. Im so grateful that you showed me time and time again that when things are hard (speaking like it was the end of the world smh) i know i can count on you. And this is why i love you <3
